2122534294656626882.en_summary: I think you need to believe what companies are saying in their earnings call for AI demand. Microsoft CFO Amy Hood: customer demand continues to exceed available supply, Azure guidance next quarter 49% to 50% growth in constant currency. Alphabet working to bring more capacity online. Amazon Andy Jassy: overall demand for AWS capacity remains exceptionally strong, expects about $220 billion of 2026 cash capex, more in 2027. Coreweave: about 10x as much qualified demand as available capacity through end of 2027. Oracle Clay Magouyrk: demand for all accelerator types far exceeding ability to supply them for next several years. $MSFT $ORCL $AMZN $CRWV $GOOGL
